moved.sentence: Use when clients drive aggregation across many resources and over/under-fetching with REST is a measured problem.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the subject made explicit: GraphQL when clients drive aggregation across many resources and REST over/under-fetching is a measured problem.

moved.sentence: **Choose GraphQL when** first-party clients need to compose data from several sources in one round trip and field-level shape varies by screen.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD inside the same rule: choose GraphQL when first-party clients compose data from several sources in one round trip and field-level shape varies by screen.

moved.sentence: Caching is field-level and client-driven, not HTTP-intermediary; do not assume CDN caching applies.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD NOT (unkeyed before), scoped to GraphQL as its section was: caching is field-level and client-driven, so CDN caching is not assumed.

moved.sentence: Treat the schema as a versioned contract; prefer additive evolution and field deprecation over breaking changes.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD, scoped to the GraphQL schema: a versioned contract, with additive evolution and field deprecation preferred over breaking changes.

moved.sentence: Use for low-latency internal service-to-service calls and streaming, per the official model (RPC over HTTP/2 with Protocol Buffers as the IDL and serialization; see references).

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with the subject made explicit: gRPC for low-latency internal calls and streaming per the official HTTP/2 + Protocol Buffers model, with the references pointer.

moved.sentence: **Choose gRPC when** callers are internal services, latency/throughput matter, you want generated client/server stubs across languages, or you need uni-/bi-directional streaming.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD inside the same rule with all four conditions for choosing gRPC.

moved.sentence: **Choose REST when** consumers are diverse/external, resources map cleanly to URLs, and HTTP caching (`ETag`, `Cache-Control`, CDN) adds value.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with all three conditions and the HTTP caching examples.

moved.sentence: It **SHOULD** be the default unless a measured need (latency, streaming, fan-out) justifies another style.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD with 'it' made explicit as REST and the measured-need exception and its examples.

moved.sentence: Pin contracts to a dated OpenAPI revision; version the API (`/v1`) per `api-design`.

judged.note: Kept at SHOULD: pin contracts to a dated OpenAPI revision and version the API (`/v1`) per `api-design`.
